title: Advanced LINQ Concepts
description: Learn advanced LINQ concepts including expression trees, sequence equality, sample queries, and the complete operator reference.
longDescription: This module covers advanced LINQ concepts. You'll learn about expression trees and how they enable LINQ providers, compare sequences, explore real-world sample queries, and review the complete standard query operator reference.
whatYouLearn: Understand expression trees and their role in LINQ providers
Review the complete standard query operator reference
